question: Jaundiced eye
options: A critical or negative way of looking at things
A person with a medical eye condition
To have a very sharp vision
To look at someone with love
solution: जब कोई कड़वाहट या पक्षपात की वजह से किसी चीज़ को नकारात्मक नज़रिए (negative view) से देखता है, तो उसे "Jaundiced eye" कहते हैं।

question: Jury is out
options: To go for a long holiday
It is not yet decided
Everyone is in agreement
The decision has been made
solution: जब किसी मामले में अभी तक कोई अंतिम निर्णय (not yet decided) न हुआ हो या लोगों की राय बंटी हुई हो।

question: Jump through hoops
options: To be very lazy and inactive
To do many difficult things to get what you want
To perform in a circus show
To find an easy way to success
solution: 'बहुत पापड़ बेलना' - यानी अपना लक्ष्य पाने के लिए कई कठिन और थकाऊ कार्यों (difficult things) से गुजरना।

question: Jump on the bandwagon
options: To join a popular trend or activity
To fall from a moving train
To criticize a famous person
To drive a heavy vehicle
solution: 'बहती गंगा में हाथ धोना' - यानी किसी ऐसे काम या विचार का हिस्सा बन जाना जो उस समय बहुत लोकप्रिय (popular trend) हो रहा हो।

question: Jump down someone's throat
options: To react to someone in a very angry way
To help someone who is choking
To speak very softly to someone
To swallow something quickly
solution: बिना किसी बड़ी बात के किसी पर बुरी तरह चिल्लाना या उसे फटकारना (to react angrily)।

question: Jump out of one's skin
options: To be extremely surprised or frightened
To undergo a medical surgery
To feel very comfortable in a place
To change one's lifestyle completely
solution: जब कोई व्यक्ति अचानक बहुत ज़्यादा चौंक जाता है या डर जाता है (extremely surprised or frightened)।

question: Jump in with both feet
options: To dive into a swimming pool
To fail in a task due to lack of planning
To be very careful before starting
To become involved in something without hesitation
solution: किसी काम या योजना में बिना किसी हिचकिचाहट के पूरे जोश के साथ कूद पड़ना (involved without hesitation)।

question: Jog someone's memory
options: To ask a lot of confusing questions
To lose one's ability to think
To remind someone of something forgotten
To run with a friend to stay healthy
solution: "Jog someone's memory" का अर्थ है किसी को पुरानी भूली हुई बात याद दिलाना (to remind someone)।

question: Jump the shark
options: To go for an adventurous ocean trip
To survive a dangerous animal attack
To become a master of a difficult skill
A point where the quality of something begins to decline
solution: यह उस स्थिति के लिए उपयोग होता है जब किसी चीज़ (जैसे टीवी शो या ब्रांड) की लोकप्रियता या गुणवत्ता में गिरावट (decline) आने लगती है।

question: Jump the gun
options: To wait for a signal to start
To act before the right time
To clean a weapon carefully
To win a shooting competition
solution: समय से पहले या बहुत जल्दबाजी में (prematurely) कोई काम कर देना।

question: Jockey for position
options: To work as a stable boy
To give up one's seat
To ride a horse in a race
To compete for a favourable position
solution: इसका मतलब है बेहतर स्थिति या फायदे के लिए दूसरों से प्रतिस्पर्धा (compete) करना।

question: Jump at the opportunity (or chance)
options: To jump over an obstacle
To miss a golden chance
To eagerly accept an opportunity
To be afraid of a new task
solution: 'मौके पर चौका मारना' - यानी जब कोई अवसर मिले तो उसे बिना सोचे बहुत उत्साह से स्वीकार (eagerly accept) कर लेना।

question: Jack up the rates
options: To lower the prices slightly
To keep the rates stable
To increase prices or rates significantly
To offer a huge discount
solution: "Jack up the rates" का अर्थ है अचानक और बहुत अधिक दाम बढ़ा देना (to increase prices suddenly)।
